Box.about: A container with a background, border, shadow, radius and padding (inside the background); the card's root, with color surface. alignment places its child inside it.

Column.about: Blocks stacked top to bottom. justify spreads them when the column has a height.

Row.about: Blocks side by side; scroll: true makes a sideways carousel (its padding scrolls with it). justify spreads the blocks, e.g. space_between.

Image.about: A network image from an https URL; full width unless width is set. fit cover (default) crops it to fill, fill stretches it, contain shows all of it.

Text.about: A line or paragraph of text. style picks a theme text style; size, weight, lineHeight, letterSpacing and font override it for this text. spans (instead of text) colours parts of it.

Icon.about: One icon: a built-in one or one the app registered, drawn at size in color (default muted).

Chip.about: A small rounded label: floor, rating, category.

Header.about: A section title with an icon tile; a chevron when it has an action.

InfoRow.about: An icon and one line of text with a divider under it: hours, phone, website.

Button.about: A full-width button; primary uses accent, secondary uses chip.

Divider.about: A thin line in the border colour, between parts of a card; padding gives it room around.
